scope: The standing Anglican cathedral exterior, including the original Gothic Revival church, crossing, Sainte-Catherine entry and present 1940 replacement steeple.

originalReview.notes: The New York Public Library rendition and full-resolution transfer show the identical period postcard. Both show the title, publisher and copyright date of 1902 on the front. The depicted height and taper of the contemporary stone spire inform the rebuilt exterior alongside the current conservation record.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the story’s published media. The only public-domain local candidate depicts a bus. The exact New York Public Library original postcard is dated by the publisher’s printed 1902 notice and corroborated against the archived scan.
